root_cause.text: The ath12k mac flush operation only called wiphy_work_flush() when a non-NULL vif was provided, missing the case where hardware-wide flush (vif=NULL) occurs, leading to a deadlock because the flush holds the wiphy lock while waiting for management transmission completion, but the transmission work item requires the same wiphy lock to run.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `wiphy_work_flush()` call before the `if (!vif)` early return, ensuring it executes for both hardware (vif=NULL) and per-vif flushes. The CVE description confirms the deadlock scenario: "Since wiphy lock has been taken by the flush process, the transmission work item has no chance to run, hence the dead lock."
